newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan Sept output seen edging down m/m.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan Sept output seen edging down m/m.

text.p: Japan's industrial production is likely to fall 0.25 percent in September month-on-month, according to an average of forecasts by economic research institutions polled by Reuters.
Institutions' forecasts ranged from a month-on-month fall of 1.8 percent to a rise of 1.5 percent. Preliminary data for September is due to be released on Tuesday.
In August, industrial output fell a revised 2.3 percent from July.

Daiwa Bank Research Institute said production in the automobile industry rose substantially in September, while output in the electronics industry fell due to sluggish sales of semiconductors. Investment adjustment pressure persists in the steel industry, it added.
